headings.h1: Toolbar for related actions and formatting

intro: Compose action buttons, formatting toggles, links, and groups in a toolbar with one keyboard entry point. Explore horizontal and vertical layouts, RTL navigation, wrapping, and 26 themeable appearances.
useCases: Related links and actions in workspaces.

faqs.question: How does keyboard navigation work?
faqs.answer: After hydration, Tab enters at the first available item, then returns to the most recently focused item. Horizontal arrows follow the reading direction; vertical toolbars use Up/Down. Home and End jump to the edges, and loop defaults to true.

faqs.question: Can I compose an existing Button?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wrap a single focusable control in ToolbarItem. It must forward props and ref to its DOM element. For links or non-native widgets, set native=false and implement their disabled semantics.

faqs.question: Do arrows activate toggle buttons?
faqs.answer: No. Arrows only move focus. Click, Enter, or Space activate ToolbarToggle. Use pressed and onPressedChange for controlled state, or defaultPressed for local state.

faqs.question: How does Toolbar handle disabled and hidden items?
faqs.answer: Disabled, aria-disabled, hidden, and inert managed items are skipped. Root disabled disables all managed actions and blocks link activation. Changes to items update the keyboard entry point.

faqs.question: What happens on mobile?
faqs.answer: Controls wrap by default. Set wrap=false and provide a scrolling container when you want a single row. Navigation follows DOM order across rows.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body: Groups related commands with button, toggle, link, item, group, and separator primitives. Supports 26 appearances, three sizes, and paired theme tokens.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body: Name each toolbar, label icon-only controls, and group at least three related actions. Native buttons and links preserve activation semantics, while roving tabindex reduces repeated Tab stops. Prevented events and nested widget navigation are respected.
